definition: A measured register of the fifteen RF08 series, not a re-measurement of any of them. Each series row is read twice: from the app registry (edition id, evidence status, editorial status, the text pin, and the three attestation roles with the artifact pin they share) and from the files on disk (the frozen text's actual sha256 and byte count, the ledger's actual sha256 and byte count). Two booleans per row are the whole test: does the measured text hash equal the pin the register records, and does the measured ledger hash equal the pin the three attestations share. A false in either fails this build. The claim disposition split is read from each edition's own ledger, never restated from its prose, and the two ledgers that carry no `legacyClaims` block are recorded as that state rather than as zero claims. What this ledger does NOT do: it re-measures no study's subject, so no figure from another edition appears here as a finding; it records which edition owns each legacy sentence and what that edition's ledger says it did with it. A summary page that restated a sibling's number would be a copy of an unverified measurement, and two of the programme's blocking defects were exactly prose outrunning a ledger.
